title: What the Bureau Kept
description: Danika Oberlin has discovered an active BNI intelligence operation inside Tyvaren territory. Shutting it down means going blind on the Gravenmark Pass. Keeping it means betraying the reform mandate. There is no clean option.

title: The Architect's Question
description: Jonas wants to talk about the welfare cuts. Not as a political opponent — as your husband who needs to believe you still have a moral compass.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora filed a records request about her grandfather. The answer came back.

title: Sons of Chancellors
description: Tomas was cornered by older boys — sons of Halvekist families. He needs you.

title: Budget Allocation — Emergency Revision
description: The BNI crisis has consumed the week, but the deficit isn't waiting. Adjust fiscal priorities before the quarter closes.

title: Cabinet Briefing — First Month Review
description: Regular cabinet session. Vostane wants to discuss the IMA letter that arrived this morning. Maric wants to discuss Vostane.
